title: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center login.cgi Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the login.cgi endpoint. The issue results from improper implementation of the authentication algorithm. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
addtionnal_details:
Cisco has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-fmc-static-cred-BET3Cjh
timeline:

2026-08-11 - Coordinated public release of advisory
